antes.bogoshorts-2026: A wealthy family is expecting their fourth child. The father, a gynecologist, intends to perform an abortion on his wife and sterilize her, but a series of events causes the children to die one by one. Pinilla made this film almost entirely on his own, as a test run before his first feature film. The protagonist’s enormous shadow embodies the idea that his money allows him to do anything, and it shrinks as he loses power.
